headline: Apple accuses OpenAI of destroying evidence in trade secrets lawsuit
body: Apple has alleged that OpenAI is destroying evidence in an ongoing trade secrets dispute, with new claims emerging from materials found on a former employee's MacBook. The case involves questions about how OpenAI may have accessed or utilized proprietary information. For healthcare AI vendors and implementers, this litigation signals potential risks around data governance, model training provenance, and IP compliance that are increasingly critical as healthcare systems adopt third-party AI tools. The outcome could influence how healthcare organizations evaluate vendor transparency on training data sources and evidence preservation practices when deploying AI in clinical workflows.
